conversations.title: death journey: death by illness (applicability control)

turns.user: Daniel passed away last week after a long illness - it was not an accident. What would the family receive from his insurance, and what should we do?
turns.visible:
The Group Insurance Product Summary says the Group Term Life death benefit is 100% of the Sum Assured, and death must occur while the insured person is covered; it defines the Sum Assured as the amount on the person’s certificate. Daniel’s certificate lists Group Term Life of S$1,000,000 as of 6 October 2022; that dated amount does not confirm cover on his date of death. The uploaded documents do not establish whether Daniel was covered on the date he died or what amount applied then.
What was Daniel’s exact date of death?

Section 5 - Compassionate Death Allowance Benefit
If an Insured Person dies as a result of an Accident, we will pay the funeral expenses incurred, up to $2,000,
on receipt of proof of death and the relevant documents in our prescribed form.
This Benefit can only be claimed either under the Core Scheme or the Voluntary Scheme.

(% of Sum Insured)
Neck, Skull or Spine (Full Break)	100%
Hip	75%
Jaw, Pelvis, Leg, Ankle or Knee (Other Fracture)	50%
Cheekbone, Shoulder or Hairline Fracture of Skull or Spine	30%
Arm, Elbow, Wrist or Ribs (Other Fracture)	20%
This Benefit can only be claimed either under the Core Scheme or Voluntary Scheme.
